snippet.title: Bloom Blast Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP19 trailer for Bloom Blast game.

Follow Cyp the cat on their quest to sell plants all over the world. Tap plants of the same color to serve customers and progress in your quest! Coming soon.

2019
